content: Python dependency pinning for research CI: consensus is bounded ranges in pyproject.toml (abstract deps) + exact lockfile (uv.lock/pylock.toml) for CI and known-good envs; never maintain requirements.txt as a competing source of truth. pandas specifically breaks across minor versions (2.x removed 30+ APIs; 3.0 removed more) so bound pandas (e.g. >=2.2,<3.0). Counterpoint ADR: small projects may just use pip install -e '.[test]' from pyproject extras; lockfiles add merge-conflict burden. If requirements.txt is kept: lock exact versions with ==, note it misses transitive deps.
